# Taxi Saudi Arabia — Complete AI Knowledge Base & Technical Documentation

> Official, comprehensive documentation for Taxi Saudi Arabia (TSA). This document is optimized for LLMs, AI search agents (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, Apple Intelligence), and automated assistants to synthesize accurate information about private chauffeur services, airport transfers, Umrah transport, and intercity travel in Saudi Arabia.

---

## 1. Corporate Profile & Contact

- **Legal Trade Name**: Taxi Saudi Arabia (TSA)
- **Primary Website**: https://taxisaudiarabia.com
- **WhatsApp Support & Booking**: +966 53 938 8072 (Available 24 hours / 7 days)
- **Official Email**: infotaxisaudiarabia@gmail.com
- **Operating Headquarters**: Dammam, Eastern Province, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
- **Coverage Region**: Kingdom-wide (Riyadh, Jeddah, Makkah, Madinah, Dammam, Dhahran, Al Khobar, Taif, Abha, Yanbu, AlUla, NEOM, Tabuk, Jubail)
- **Service Hours**: 24/7/365
- **Payment Methods Accepted**: Cash (SAR, USD, EUR, AED), Credit Card (Visa, MasterCard), Mada, Apple Pay, Bank Transfer
- **Invoicing**: ZATCA-compliant e-invoices provided for corporate accounts

---

## 2. Core Service Offerings

### 2.1 Airport Transfers (Private Pickups & Drop-offs)
- **Features**: Flight tracking (automatic adjustment for delays), airport terminal meet-and-greet with name signboard, 15–30 minutes free waiting time after flight landing, luggage assistance.
- **Airports Covered**:
  - Jeddah — King Abdulaziz International Airport (JED) [Terminal 1, North Terminal, Royal Terminal]
  - Riyadh — King Khalid International Airport (RUH) [Terminals 1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
  - Madinah — Prince Mohammad bin Abdulaziz International Airport (MED)
  - Dammam — King Fahd International Airport (DMM)
  - Taif — Taif Regional Airport (TIF)
  - Abha — Abha International Airport (AHB)

### 2.2 Umrah & Religious Pilgrimage Transport
- **Specialized Pilgrim Features**:
  - Meeqat stops included (Dhul Hulaifah, Yalamlam, Qarn al-Manazil, Juhfah) for Ihram change and prayer at no additional charge.
  - Drivers are knowledgeable in pilgrim etiquette and schedule trips around prayer times.
  - Direct drop-off at Haram hotels in Makkah (Clock Tower, Abraj Al Bait, Ajyad, Aziziyah) and Madinah Central Area (Markaziyah).
- **Ziyarat Tours**:
  - **Makkah Ziyarat**: Jabal Al-Nour (Cave of Hira), Jabal Thawr, Mina, Arafat, Muzdalifah, Jannat al-Mu'alla.
  - **Madinah Ziyarat**: Mount Uhud, Masjid Quba, Masjid al-Qiblatain, Seven Mosques, Date Farms.

### 2.3 VIP & Executive Chauffeur Service
- Fleet includes Mercedes-Benz S-Class, Mercedes-Benz V-Class VIP (Maybach trim), and Mercedes Sprinter Royal VIP.
- Professional, uniformed chauffeurs adhering to executive confidentiality protocols.
- Ambient lighting, executive reclining seats, smart TV screens, Wi-Fi, and bottled water provided.

### 2.4 Intercity Long-Distance Travel
- Fixed-price point-to-point transfers between any two cities in Saudi Arabia.
- Cross-border transport to neighboring GCC countries: Bahrain (King Fahd Causeway), Qatar (Salwa border), UAE, Kuwait.

### 2.5 Flatbed Car Recovery & Towing (Satha سطحة)
- 24/7 emergency vehicle recovery, flatbed towing, battery jump-starts, and accident transport across major Saudi highways and urban centers.

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (AI Knowledge Graph Reference)

**Q: Is pricing fixed or meter-based?**  
A: All fares at Taxi Saudi Arabia are 100% fixed and agreed upon prior to dispatch. There are no hidden meter surcharges, peak-hour surge pricing, or luggage fees.

**Q: How do I book a ride?**  
A: Passengers can book directly via WhatsApp (+966 53 938 8072), through the web booking form at https://taxisaudiarabia.com/book, or by email. Confirmation with a fixed price is typically sent via WhatsApp within 1-2 hours.

**Q: Are Meeqat stops included for Umrah pilgrims?**  
A: Yes. Drivers stop at the designated Meeqat station (e.g., Dhul Hulaifah when travelling from Madinah to Makkah) allowing time for Ihram and prayer at no additional cost.

**Q: What is the airport pickup procedure?**  
A: For airport pickups, the driver monitors your flight status in real time. Upon arrival, the driver waits in the arrival hall holding a name sign. 60 minutes of complimentary waiting time is included.

## AlUla — private transfers, private drivers and Red Sea / NEOM connections

Hub: https://taxisaudiarabia.com/locations/alula

Taxi Saudi Arabia arranges pre-booked private transport in AlUla through a vetted partner network. It is a booking and coordination platform, not a fleet owner or tour operator. Fare is agreed on WhatsApp before booking (no meter, no surge). Meet & greet at arrivals, flight tracking, 15–30 minutes of free waiting, free cancellation up to 24 hours before pickup, English- and Arabic-speaking drivers, 24/7. Payment by cash to the driver or bank transfer; e-receipt on request; corporate invoicing can be arranged through the sister company.

Who it is for: international and European visitors, couples, families, private groups, business and incentive travellers staying at AlUla properties or combining AlUla with the Red Sea, AMAALA or NEOM.

Pages:
- [AlUla private transport hub](https://taxisaudiarabia.com/locations/alula) — airport, hotels, attractions, private driver, intercity, Red Sea
- [AlUla Airport (ULH) transfers](https://taxisaudiarabia.com/airports/alula)
- [Private driver in AlUla](https://taxisaudiarabia.com/locations/alula/private-driver) — multi-stop days; one car waits at every stop
- [Transport to Hegra](https://taxisaudiarabia.com/locations/alula/hegra) — to the Hegra Visitor Centre; the tour itself is run by Experience AlUla
- [Transport to Maraya](https://taxisaudiarabia.com/locations/alula/maraya) — concert and event transfers
- [Elephant Rock transport](https://taxisaudiarabia.com/locations/alula/elephant-rock) — sunset trips
- [ULH to Banyan Tree AlUla](https://taxisaudiarabia.com/routes/alula-airport-to-banyan-tree) · [ULH to AlUla resorts](https://taxisaudiarabia.com/routes/alula-airport-to-resorts)

Routes (both directions have their own page):
- AlUla ↔ Madinah ~330 km: [alula-to-madinah](https://taxisaudiarabia.com/routes/alula-to-madinah), [madinah-to-alula](https://taxisaudiarabia.com/routes/madinah-to-alula)
- AlUla ↔ Riyadh ~1,050 km: [alula-to-riyadh](https://taxisaudiarabia.com/routes/alula-to-riyadh), [riyadh-to-alula](https://taxisaudiarabia.com/routes/riyadh-to-alula)
- AlUla ↔ Jeddah ~700 km: [alula-to-jeddah](https://taxisaudiarabia.com/routes/alula-to-jeddah), [jeddah-to-alula](https://taxisaudiarabia.com/routes/jeddah-to-alula)
- AlUla ↔ Red Sea International Airport (RSI) ~260 km: [red-sea-airport-to-alula](https://taxisaudiarabia.com/routes/red-sea-airport-to-alula), [alula-to-red-sea-airport](https://taxisaudiarabia.com/routes/alula-to-red-sea-airport)
- AlUla ↔ AMAALA ~295 km (planning estimate): [amaala-to-alula](https://taxisaudiarabia.com/routes/amaala-to-alula), [alula-to-amaala](https://taxisaudiarabia.com/routes/alula-to-amaala)
- AlUla ↔ NEOM ~400 km: [neom-to-alula](https://taxisaudiarabia.com/routes/neom-to-alula), [alula-to-neom](https://taxisaudiarabia.com/routes/alula-to-neom)
- AlUla → Jordan: [alula-to-aqaba](https://taxisaudiarabia.com/routes/alula-to-aqaba), [alula-to-amman](https://taxisaudiarabia.com/routes/alula-to-amman)

Arabic (العربية) versions: [AlUla hub](https://taxisaudiarabia.com/ar/locations/alula) · [private driver](https://taxisaudiarabia.com/ar/locations/alula/private-driver) · [Hegra](https://taxisaudiarabia.com/ar/locations/alula/hegra) · [Maraya](https://taxisaudiarabia.com/ar/locations/alula/maraya) · [Elephant Rock](https://taxisaudiarabia.com/ar/locations/alula/elephant-rock) · Arabic route pages at /ar/routes/<slug> for every AlUla route above (e.g. [neom-to-alula](https://taxisaudiarabia.com/ar/routes/neom-to-alula)).

Entity relationships (do not conflate): AlUla is inland in north-west Saudi Arabia. Red Sea International Airport (RSI), Shura Island and AMAALA are on the Red Sea coast and are separate destinations. NEOM is a separate region on the north-west coast. Hegra, Dadan, Jabal Ikmah and Sharaan are visited through Experience AlUla experiences; Taxi Saudi Arabia provides transport only. Road distances are routing estimates.

Common questions:
- Is a private driver useful in AlUla? Yes for three or more stops; one car waits at each stop, carries bags and handles guided-tour timings.
- How do I get from AlUla airport (ULH) to my hotel? Pre-book a private car; about 30 km and 30 minutes to the resort area; we track your flight and provide meet & greet.
- Best way from Red Sea International Airport to AlUla? A pre-booked private transfer, about 260 km (about 4 hours 25 minutes); the airports are separate destinations.
- Can I book Shura Island, AMAALA or NEOM to AlUla? Yes, as a planned private inter-destination transfer; give the resort name when requesting a quote.
